title: YourMondayMotivator: New year, new me, new you?
html:
New year, new me, new you? Bit of a throwaway subject line but it got me thinking and Steven Spielberg even had a quote that worked with it -“All of us every single year, we're a different person. I don't think we're the same person all our lives." In case you hadn't realised it today is the 7th of January. New Zealand is still on holiday but a lot of us will be back at work, changed and raring to go. The country / world will not be on the same page as us. They will still be dreading going to work, not fired up ready to change the world. That is hard to deal with and why a lot of resolutions fail - no one else has changed enough to accept you want to be different this year. We want a better life this year.

Last weekI challenged you to put a goal out there for this year. By putting it out there I said it made you accountable. However there is another part of putting yourself out there that will be far more helpful this week - others will have the opportunity to support you. We all need support of someone to achieve our goals. At least one person on our side to cheer, or jeer, us through the hard times when we are about to give up. Write your challenge today and I look forward to supporting you achieve it through 2013. Have a GREAT day! Glenn P.S. I have a goal this year to effect more peoples lives and you can help. When a MondayMotivator really strikes a chord with you send it on to your friends and family. Simple and if you have any suggestions for topics drop me a line.
